purpose: Four playful 32-pose encounters and a redrawn 32-pose flipper groove, using only the approved original Moru reference.

entries.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production animation SPRITE SHEET of Moru, the ORIGINAL pixel seal in the one reference image. The reference is the exact character model: warm stone-gray rounded dome and body, generous ivory cheeks/belly, two paired navy oval eyes, navy diamond nose, exactly two short horizontal whiskers each cheek, two short indigo FLIPPERS (never hands or arms), left forked indigo tail with an ivory tip notch. Preserve its proportions and face identity in every pose.
FORMAT: EXACTLY 32 sequential frames, FOUR columns by EIGHT rows, equal SQUARE cells, row-major reading order. Portrait 1:2 canvas. Genuine transparent alpha-zero background, no grid, no lettering or numbers. Fixed camera and scale. Adult seal occupies about 70% cell width, front flippers at 78% cell height, plenty of headroom and safe side margins. First and last cells are the exact reference neutral pose. Native square pixels, hard opaque clusters, flat #171923 outline, #d6d3c9 gray, #fff1d7 ivory, #6d73d2 and #50569c indigo. No gradients, blur, soft shading, mottled skin, changing pixel sizes, accidental speckles or detached facial features. Keep the round body full throughout; no pancake squash. Detailed intermediate poses with anticipation, a clear payoff and a soft settle, not 32 unrelated drawings. Moru playfully balances ONE tiny ivory five-point star with a navy outline on its nose. Frames1-4 neutral then curious upward glance;5-9 flipper gently lifts the star onto the nose;10-18 star teeters subtly left then right while eyes track it and tail counterbalances;19-23 star slips and Moru catches it with a short flipper, giving a delighted closed-eye smile;24-28 flipper lowers and tucks the star away;29-32 settles to exact neutral. The small star is the only prop, no sparkle cloud. Every transition uses coherent small increments. Keep both eyes correct and the star clear of them.
